speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. I see you are presenting with a rash on your scalp and forehead; to help you, please describe how long you have had these symptoms and if they are itchy, painful, or oozing. Do you have a fever or any history of recent insect bites or new hair products?

speaker: Patient
text: 3-month-old boy. The parents report that the rash has been present for several weeks, noting that it sometimes appears red and scaly, especially during cold weather. The patient was born at 36 weeks' gestation and has been generally healthy since. The patient's father has a history of psoriasis.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Infantile Seborrheic Dermatitis (Cradle Cap) presenting on the scalp and forehead.
